note: The UX contract: exact strings, timings, and geometry the Electron shell must reproduce on macOS (Windows substitutes Control for Command in hotkeys only). app/src must import these values from a constants module whose unit test loads THIS file and asserts equality string-by-string.

behavior.toggleSemantics: Command+. starts when idle, stops when recording; stop enqueues transcription
behavior.cancelSemantics: Command+, only acts while recording; otherwise shows No Session
behavior.retryRobustWhileRecording: shows Stop Recording First and does nothing
behavior.pasteMechanism: set clipboard to normalized transcript, then synthetic Command+V; clipboard is NOT restored
behavior.undoReplace: if last dictation paste happened under replacementWindowSeconds ago AND frontmost app is unchanged, send Command+Z, wait replacementPasteDelaySeconds, then paste the robust transcript; otherwise paste normally
behavior.errorResult: show result.errorMessage as alert, log salvage path if present
behavior.pendingCountInAlerts: while pendingCount > 0, ready/processing alerts append ' (N)' via pendingSuffixFormat
